notes: Georgia does NOT provide a single comprehensive K-12 PDF. Instead, they provide separate PDFs for each grade band (K-5 by grade, 6-8 by grade, 9-12 by course). The GeorgiaStandards.org website has bot detection/firewall that blocks automated access. Using Grade 6 PDF as representative document. Georgia Standards of Excellence (GSE) for Science are available on GeorgiaStandards.org.
issues_encountered: No comprehensive K-12 document available - only grade-specific and course-specific PDFs
Website has firewall/bot detection that blocks automated access (Attack ID: 20000051)
Connection error may have been due to bot detection
note_about_access: GeorgiaStandards.org requires manual browser access due to security restrictions
